q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a woollen shawl?
title: Woollen shawl carbon footprint per shawl
short: Start with the wool or wool blend yarn per shawl and the yarn supplier's figure, then add weaving, dyeing, washing and finishing energy. Divide the unit's energy by shawls finished and state fibre, size and weight.

ul: Wool, acrylic or blend yarn by weight.
Power loom electricity, or handloom with no machine energy.

p: Report per shawl with fibre and weight. A pure wool shawl and an acrylic one carry very different yarn figures.

example.title: Worked example: woollen shawl unit per shawl (one month)
lines: Plant total: 7,730 / 5,000 = 1.546 kg CO2 per shawl
Add yarn and dyes for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
